fill.summaryAnswer:
— Dad was first onto the ice and held on to the barrier longer than anyone.
— The best hill took three tries — behind the garages, and it belonged to another yard.
— Four of us built the fort; by the evening there were twelve people in the yard.
— We went out half an hour early for the fireworks, froze, and got the best spot in the yard.
fill.nextIdeas:
— A month of skis: a new trail in the park every weekend.
— Bake a gingerbread house and not eat it before the holiday.
— Go where we swam in the summer and look at the ice.
— A board game month: an evening at the table instead of an evening on the phone.
